items.summary: In the HeroSection component, fix the 'Contact Sales' CTA button so it renders as the human-readable label 'Contact Sales' (English), the correct Hindi translation, and the correct Marathi translation — instead of the raw translation key (e.g., 'Hero.ctaContactSale', 'Hero.ctacontact', or any similar raw key string). Ensure the translation key used in HeroSection's JSX exactly matches the key defined in frontend/src/translations/translations.ts for all three language codes (en, hi, mr), and that the translations.ts values for this key are plain human-readable strings (not raw JSON, escaped characters, or template literal artifacts). The button must display correctly in all three language modes.
